Name: Japanese seasonal extendable windows
Author: Asterisk555
Description:
[u]Description[/u]
[list]
[*]Round extendable windows
[*]Optional file has a version using colours from DaisyNiko's earthy recolour so it's not so bright
[*]Alternative Textures and mobile compatible content patcher version available
[/list]

[u]Quick start instructions
[/u][list=1]
[*]Skip these instructions if you're downloading the content patcher version, the instructions for that are in the "Read Me" inside the mod folder
[*]Download one of the (AT)
[*]Download and extract this mod and it's requirements into your mods folder (if you are confused check out [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started#Getting_started]this guide[/url]﻿).
[*]Buy the paint bucket at Robin's shop to retexture items. There is a [url=https://youtu.be/OzCzEppsXVY]video[/url]﻿ on how to use the mod in-game.
[/list]

[u]Tips and tricks[/u]
[list]
[*]The basic, boarded, and small window has retextures
[*]The basic window is the seasonal version and sometimes looks better with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10289]window light removal[/url]﻿, while the small window has plain backgrounds which are not seasonal but look good with window light
[*]The boarded window has shoji screens, and the light is blocked so it looks more natural and like the screens are blocking the light
[/list]

[u]Recommended Mods[/u][list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10223]Light Tweaks and Auto Fireplaces[/url]
[*]Scenery in the DN version is from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]DaisyNiko's Earthy recolour[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12993]Japanese wallpapers and flooring[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12219]Chests and minifridges as baskets[/url]
[*]Industrial/Basic [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11807]extendable windows[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12404]Bathroom Extension[/url]﻿﻿
[/list]
